graphArtifacts.note: Genuine standalone induction cooktop technical manual — not freestanding range substitute

functionalArchitectureSummary.surfaceHeat: Multi-zone induction — IPC (induction power control) per zone cluster, induction coils, coil NTC, IGBT thermal monitoring
functionalArchitectureSummary.control: HMI touch UI + IPC boards; service diagnostics mode; IPC configuration after board swap
functionalArchitectureSummary.electronicsCooling: Blower/cooling fan for IPC thermal management (F7E5/F7E6)
functionalArchitectureSummary.thermalProtection: Thermofuses on power path; coil NTC overtemperature (F0EA/F0EC); IGBT NTC (F1E1)
functionalArchitectureSummary.power: Terminal block, capacitor, shunt clip; supply frequency/vbus checks (F0E6/F0E7)
functionalArchitectureSummary.ovenDomainsAbsent: No bake/broil/convection cavity, no oven RTD, no door latch — cooktop-only product
functionalArchitectureSummary.downdraft: Nomenclature documents downdraft SKUs (KD = Downdraft) but this ingested manual is induction cooktop without downdraft diagnostic section

HMI↔IPC communication error — maps to user_interface + control_board.
Coil NTC open/short and overtemperature shutdown — thermal protection on surface heat path; binds to conditionalConcept thermal_protection.
Vbus, mains frequency, fuse track, power cord connection — prerequisite power domain.
Pan compatibility/positioning — functional surface-heating authorization gate, not a separate canonical domain.
